ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points B and C divide the line segment AD into three parts in the ratio 2:3:4, and $CD=20$. If point P is the midpoint of AD, and point Q is the midpoint of CD, what is the length of line segment PQ?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point P is the midpoint of AD,\\
we have $PD=\frac{1}{2}AD=\frac{45}{2}$.\\
Since point Q is the midpoint of CD,\\
we have $QD=\frac{1}{2}CD=10$.\\
Therefore, $PQ=PD−QD=\frac{45}{2}−10=\boxed{\frac{25}{2}}$.
